scope: val_identity 62-frame development batch + saved inner_north predictions; image evidence only for identity reasoning

single_network_probe.description: frozen single-class model run once over the 62 development identity frames; no training/retuning; results are dev evidence only

raw_sensitivity.note: threshold-sensitivity probe, not the frozen operating point

TARGET.note: green area ~ distance^slope; slope about -2 means inverse-square apparent size

MS1.note: green area ~ distance^slope; slope about -2 means inverse-square apparent size

combined_gate.rule: identity ACCEPT only if aspect_ratio>=0.50; if a reference keypoint is emitted also require green_rel_y>=0.18; otherwise UNKNOWN/REJECT

feature_compute_benchmark.note: host CPU only, pure-python; RK3576 board cost UNKNOWN (no board test)

single_network_reasons: the network output is class tower + one keypoint; it has no identity channel, appearance_check=NOT_EVALUATED and landmark_id is claimed from single-candidate score/margin only

frozen model produced 0 false identity claims on 9 MS1-alone frames (0/9; 95% one-sided upper bound 28.3%) and 0 claims on 9 GT-unobservable frames; this bounds the observed dev error, it does not establish identity capability

the retrained v4 baseline detected MS1 as a second candidate in 1/30 inner_north frames (scores 0.792/0.411, margin 0.381 > tau_margin 0.1, target top1) - the network can represent MS1; suppression relies on score margin and view distribution, not identity reasoning

in matched-scale both-visible frames the frozen model detected only the target (candidate_count=1) and never the MS1 object, while under-detecting the target in 9/9 same-bearing frames at the frozen threshold - behaviour is threshold/view dependent
verdicts.appearance_gate_rule: identity ACCEPT only if bbox aspect_ratio >= 0.50; if a reference keypoint is emitted also require green_rel_y >= 0.18; otherwise UNKNOWN (never silently map to the central tower)

appearance_gate_cost_on_dev.rule: identity ACCEPT only if aspect_ratio>=0.50; if a reference keypoint is emitted also require green_rel_y>=0.18; otherwise UNKNOWN/REJECT

carrying_cues.bbox_aspect_ratio: target 0.632-1.778 (median 1.461) vs MS1 0.201-0.438 (median 0.326); AUC 1.0; threshold 0.50 gives 0 false-block / 0 miss-block on 44/35 objects
carrying_cues.green_rel_y: target 0.212-0.396 (median 0.242) vs MS1 0.062-0.122 (median 0.093); AUC 1.0; threshold 0.18 separates; only measurable when the reference keypoint is emitted (44 objects -> 18 target / 26 MS1)
carrying_cues.green_rel_x: overlapping (target/reference vs MS1) -> NOT a gate cue
carrying_cues.axis_symmetry: overlapping (target median 0.65 vs MS1 0.43, ranges 0.17-1.0 vs 0.0-0.95) -> weak, not a gate cue alone
carrying_cues.top_body_width_ratio: overlapping and segmentation-sensitive (AUC 0.56) -> not recommended until a verified measurement exists
carrying_cues.green_area_px: overlapping and range-confounded (target slope -2.46 vs MS1 -1.81 in log-log, R2 0.94/0.78); cannot be used without range, and the consumer has no range

verdicts.compute_cost: gate needs the bbox only (aspect) plus the reference keypoint plus the already-computed strict-green component; host pure-python feature extraction 0.072-0.185 s/frame for 320x240 (cached green components lower this); RK3576 board cost UNKNOWN (no board test)

cost_of_errors.false_block (target rejected): identity becomes UNKNOWN; landmark relay loses one visibility fix (availability cost, recoverable by the next frame; no safety violation)
cost_of_errors.miss_block (MS1 accepted): false landmark/region hypothesis; violates the V2.2 consumer guardrail (identity false match worse than miss); safety-relevant
cost_of_errors.design choice: prefer false-block over miss-block; gate must never claim identity when the reference point is unavailable

applicability_domain: development identity batch only: 320x240 synthetic RGB, one Isaac asset/session, 7 cases, 62 annotated frames, agent-proxy labels
not valid below ~20 px bbox height (the TINY blind test showed 9-14 px targets are not reliably annotatable) -> identity UNKNOWN there
MS1 verification is map-native (WORLD_POSE_OR_MAP_DB); MS2 symmetric candidate appearance UNKNOWN; real-arena confuser distribution UNKNOWN
no certification, no holdout, no board/real-camera claim; gate thresholds are PROPOSED and need new untouched data to freeze

boundaries: image evidence only for identity; map positions used only to normalise the green-area/range relation
